lead: An `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` section's `-->` line is indented by the width of the line number, and any edit above the code moves the number.
body: The gutter is `" ".repeat(digits) + " --> "`, counted from `--FILE--`'s first line, so a neighbour's two-space `  --> case.nvs:9:40` copied onto a case whose error is on line 14 fails with a diff whose halves look identical. Run `python tools/try.py <case>` and copy the whole location line verbatim.
